# Support button artwork

Official artwork downloaded on 2026-11-20 for the creator’s requested support links:

- `kofi-cup.png`: https://storage.ko-fi.com/cdn/cup-border.png, referenced by Ko-fi’s official https://storage.ko-fi.com/cdn/widget/Widget_2.js. Ferge adapts that widget’s button styling to its blue palette, without running the remote script or loading Google Fonts.
- `buy-me-a-coffee.png`: https://cdn.buymeacoffee.com/buttons/v2/default-yellow.png, the official yellow Buy Me a Coffee button, used unchanged.

These brand assets belong to their respective services. They are served locally; the buttons are ordinary outbound links without embedded donation widgets or tracking.

Header icons supplied by the user on 2026-11-23:

- `kofi-symbol.webp`: copied unchanged from the supplied Ko-fi symbol.
- `bmc-logo.png`: copied unchanged from the supplied Buy Me a Coffee logo.

The header displays these at a small size between the brand and file actions. White icon backgrounds preserve the original artwork's contrast on dark themes. Help retains the existing larger support buttons.
